facts.claim: Planning Data Green belt contains boundaries for land designated by a local planning authority as green belt.
Local planning authorities provide Green belt annual returns in March.
Planning Data says Green belt annual-return data is published in autumn.
The Green belt dataset is a snapshot and may not reflect boundary changes after annual returns were submitted.
The current Green belt dataset reports 190 green-belt records.
The current Green belt dataset reports one data provider.
The Green belt collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New Green belt data was last found on 10 May 2026.
Planning Data says Green belt contains some MHCLG-created data while replacement with authoritative sources continues.
Flood risk zones are an Environment Agency guide to probability of river and sea flooding in England.
Flood zone 1 areas are described as least likely to flood.
Flood zone 3 areas are described as more likely to flood.
Planning Data warns flood zones cannot say whether a specific location will definitely flood or to what severity.
The Flood risk zone dataset reports 780636 records.
The Flood risk zone dataset reports one data provider.
The Flood risk zone collector last ran on 1 November 2023.
New Flood risk zone data was last found on 24 August 2023.
Planning Data labels the Flood risk zone origin as all data from authoritative sources.
The Listed building dataset covers special architectural or historic buildings with legal protection.
Planning Data says Listed building data can guide conservation efforts.
Listed building records show a point within the building and do not define the extent affected by the listing.
The current Listed building dataset reports 382254 records.
The current Listed building dataset reports two data providers.
The Listed building collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New Listed building data was last found on 25 July 2026.
Listed building origin includes some MHCLG-created data while replacement with authoritative sources continues.
The Listed building page attributes Historic England and Ordnance Survey data.
The Listed building dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0.
Listed building outline contains geospatial boundary or extent information about listings.
Planning Data says Listed building outline does not consistently show listed-building curtilage for planning purposes.
Planning Data says Listed building outline should be used only as an indicative guide.
Planning Data encourages further checks before making planning decisions from Listed building outline data.
Listed building outline is explicitly described as work in progress.
Listed building outline does not have full coverage across England.
The current Listed building outline dataset reports 124927 records.
The current Listed building outline dataset reports 96 data providers.
The Listed building outline collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New Listed building outline data was last found on 26 July 2026.
Planning Data says Listed building outline is MHCLG-created data pending authoritative replacement.
Local nature reserves are statutory designations for certain nature reserves in Great Britain.
The current Local nature reserve dataset reports 1727 reserves.
The current Local nature reserve dataset reports two data providers.
The Local nature reserve collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New Local nature reserve data was last found on 19 June 2026.
Local nature reserve origin includes some MHCLG-created data while authoritative replacement continues.
The Local nature reserve dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0.
Tree preservation order data contains information on trees with preservation orders.
Planning Data describes preservation orders as helping prevent unauthorised removal or damage to important trees.
Planning Data says the dataset can be used to check whether a tree is protected.
Planning Data says the dataset can inform planning applications or tree-work proposals.
The current Tree preservation order dataset reports 107674 orders.
The current Tree preservation order dataset reports 74 data providers.
The Tree preservation order collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New Tree preservation order data was last found on 26 July 2026.
Tree preservation order origin includes some MHCLG-created data while authoritative replacement continues.
The Tree dataset represents extents of groups of trees covered by a tree preservation order.
Planning Data says Tree data currently comes from a small group of local planning authorities.
The current Tree dataset reports 247863 trees.
The current Tree dataset reports 74 data providers.
The Tree collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New Tree data was last found on 26 July 2026.
Tree origin includes some MHCLG-created data while authoritative replacement continues.
The Tree dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0.
Local Planning Authority data contains the administrative boundary for each LPA in England.
Planning Data says LPA boundaries can assist production of planning and other statistics.
Planning Data says LPA boundaries can help identify the authority responsible for a planning application on a map.
The current LPA dataset reports 337 Local Planning Authorities.
The current LPA dataset reports two data providers.
The LPA collector last ran on 26 July 2026.
New LPA data was last found on 18 July 2026.
LPA attribution identifies Office for National Statistics and Ordnance Survey data.
LPA origin includes some MHCLG-created data while authoritative replacement continues.
Local authority district data contains administrative boundaries provided by ONS for statistics.
The current Local authority district dataset reports 344 districts.
The current Local authority district dataset reports two data providers.
The Local authority district collector last ran on 25 July 2026.
New Local authority district data was last found on 6 June 2026.
Local authority district origin includes some MHCLG-created data while authoritative replacement continues.
Local authority district attribution identifies ONS and Ordnance Survey data.
Brownfield site is an experimental dataset of brownfield-site boundaries found on data.gov.uk and local planning authority websites.
Planning Data expects Brownfield site to be combined with Brownfield land in future.
The Brownfield site dataset reports 2916 sites.
The Brownfield site dataset reports five data providers.
The Brownfield site collector last ran on 23 July 2026.
New Brownfield site data was last found on 19 December 2025.
Brownfield site data is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
Brownfield site is licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0.
Enfield says it is required by the Brownfield Land Register Regulations 2017 to publish a register of previously developed land.
Enfield says its Brownfield Land Register has two parts and is reviewed at least once per year.
Enfield Part 1 requires sites to be previously developed land under the stated criteria.
Enfield Part 1 requires at least 0.25 hectares or capacity for at least five homes.
Enfield Part 1 sites must be suitable, available and achievable.
Enfield says Part 2 is a subset of Part 1 containing sites granted Permission in Principle.
Enfield explicitly says it has no sites in Part 2 of the Brownfield Land Register.
Enfield describes its Local Development Scheme as a public project plan for preparation of development plan documents.
The Enfield LDS sets out the scope and programme for preparing development plan documents.
The Enfield LDS provides a framework for delivering the borough spatial planning strategy.
Enfield says the LDS page covers local development documents to be produced in the next four-year period.
Enfield says the LDS was updated and revised in May 2025 to align with progress on the new Local Plan.
The May 2025 Enfield LDS supersedes earlier published editions.

checks.description: Official/public source ownership and page identity checked.
The exact count, date, status, semantic statement or warning was checked against the cited source.
Currentness was checked as of 2026-07-26 and stale/snapshot/future states were preserved rather than upgraded.
Coverage, mixed-origin, indicative, point-vs-extent, experimental and snapshot limitations were kept fail-closed.
No dataset-level or borough-process statement was converted into parcel membership without exact candidate geometry/PIP evidence.
